text_block_list.text:
The three years of racing through the Twinkle Series with North Flight.
One day, in the midst of those busy days...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Over here!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Over heeeere!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's all right!
Please don't panic.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Because the cherry blossoms
are still in full bloom!"
Today, invited by North Flight, I was supposed to go cherry blossom viewing on the academy grounds with Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Trainer, you're wearing cherry blossom colors too!
choice_data_list: I put together an outfit for cherry blossom viewing!

text_block_list.text: With a light pink track jacket as the centerpiece, I put together a spring-like outfit that keeps the flashiness in check so it doesn't distract from the cherry blossoms.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: By choosing a dusty pink for this sporty track jacket, it tones it down to a mature, subtle sweetness.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Keeping the rest of the outfit clean and sharp...
Your sense of balance to keep it from looking
too casual is fantastic!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
it's absolutely wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh...!
My seal of approval!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Fashion Rep's Trainer!
You really do love fashion, don't you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Do you like it, Trainer?

As North Flight looks at me, I reflect.
Ever since meeting her, picking out clothes and standing in front of the mirror
has become so much more enjoyable—
choice_data_list: I love it even more than before!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Is that right!
...Ehehe♪

The cherry blossoms around the academy are in full bloom right now.
I see them every day, but looking at them in the context of flower viewing gives it a whole new feel.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: It's spring, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm!
So chill!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, both of you! I bought some sakura mochi!
It has such a subtle sweetness, it's absolutely exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Please relax and enjoy some sakura mochi with us!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I made a cherry blossom viewing bento too.
I added some sakura denbu to make it look festive♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaah!
I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you brought quite a lot, didn't you!
Well then, shall we take our time getting started?

Chatting with the two of them, I looked up at the cherry blossoms.
In full bloom, these flowers were a feast for the eyes with their breathtaking beauty...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Cherry blossoms... are truly beautiful, aren't they?
Though... I didn't like them that much in the past.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
F-F-F-F-F-Flight-san!
W-W-W-What d-d-did you just say!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Cherry blossoms... You do not... like sakura!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, I-I'm sorry!
I didn't mean you, Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hup!!!!
choice_data_list: But why didn't you like it?
But why didn't you like it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That really was back when we were kids, you know?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
They bloom in a flash and disappear just as fast, right?
I think that's what made her sad.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even if I become able to run,
I can't help wondering... if my racing career
might end up just like the cherry blossoms.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The full bloom ends so quickly,
and before you know it, it's already gone... or so they say.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flight-san...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Of course, right now I don't feel that way at all—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: DO NOT WORRY!!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: B-Bakushin O-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Cherry blossoms aren't fleeting at all!
Besides, sakura mochi is delicious and I want to eat it every day!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Above all else!!
Sakura Bakushin O is here!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Cherry blossoms right now
are a symbol of boundless energy!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As long as Sakura Bakushin O is around... Ms. Flight's life will always be in full bloom!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I really love
the way you think!
choice_data_list: Which meaning you wear is up to you, too.
Which meaning you wear is up to you, too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Truly... that is so.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Making choices like that...
is what brought me to where I am today.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, you two.
I... really love it now!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Everything surrounding me.
—My entire life!
